row.notes: In Game_TimeTrial_SetReference: mov rax,[rsi+0x20278] that starts the GAME log line '[TIME TRIALS] New reference : track(%d, %s), weather(%s), leaderboard(%s).' (format 0x1456e7b97), reached only when g_Ne_LogGate is enabled and holds the GAME hash 0x7c7c88cb (je 0x14147bc94 at 0x14147bc5f). rsi = the Time Trial presenter; +0x20278 is the board the lookup at 0x14147bc14 (call 0x142f8baf0 with the track and weather) stored at 0x14147bc19, 0 when no board is listed for the track (offline play has no online board list). The next instruction mov rdi,[rax+0x40] reads the board name with no null check and faults (ACCESS_VIOLATION reading 0x40 at F1_25.exe+0x147bc9b, Game_TimeTrial_SetReference+0x57b, from Game_TimeTrial_Leave+0x1ea7 on setCurrentGameMode none -> time_trial). Stock builds keep the GAME channel closed; swofty_gamelog opens it for a GAME channel rule. 7-byte patch window, no branch lands inside it. Core's time trial reference log guard continues at site_Game_TimeTrial_SetReferenceLogDone for a null board.

verify.notes: V9252 Static: disassembled 0x14147bb00..0x14147bdb0. The only writer of +0x20278 in the exe is 0x14147bc19 (scan for disp 0x20278); the store follows call 0x142f8baf0. bc94 is the je target of the GAME hash match; no branch lands in 0x14147bc95..0x14147bc9a.
